description: This Java source file defines the class FileBasedCredentialsService, which manages device credentials stored in memory backed by a file. It includes methods for loading, saving, retrieving, setting, and removing credentials, with support for resource versioning and credential validation.

classes.name: FileBasedCredentialsService
classes.description: Manages device credentials stored in memory with file persistence, supporting load, save, retrieval, update, and deletion operations with version control and credential validation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, loads credentials from file if configured, and sets up periodic saving.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and saves credentials to file if needed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a given tenant, authId, and type, with optional client context.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets credentials for a device, updating resource version and removing existing credentials.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all credentials associated with a device.

methods.name: getMaxBcryptIterations
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed bcrypt hash iterations from configuration.
